| Version source | UzPainter's selection: CPython 3.13 because Painter 12.1 ships 3.13.9 (`docs/architecture/10-python-api.md` §1); 3.13.16 (tag `v3.13.16`, released 2026-09-30) is the newest 3.13 release with Windows binaries on the retrieval date; the headers and import library come from the release's full Windows x64 package (the embeddable package has neither), listed with this SHA-256 in python.org's signed release index `windows-3.13.16.json` |
| Licence | PSF License Version 2 and the incorporated licences (`LICENSE.txt`, the same file as in `thirdparty/cpython/`) |
| Licence files | `LICENSE.txt` (verbatim) |
| Distribution role | build-only: the C API headers and the import library `libs/python313.lib` `UzPainter.exe` links against; nothing of it is shipped |
| Selected features | `include/` as distributed (the generated Windows `pyconfig.h`, GIL-enabled build) and `libs/python313.lib`; no `python3.lib`, `DLLs/`, `Lib/`, tools or Tcl/Tk |
| Include directories | `thirdparty/cpython-dev/include` |

Every file below is byte-equal to the archive member at the same path; none was taken from a UzEngine tree. `MANIFEST.json` records the SHA-256 of each file.
